'''House Stormrider''' is the house of '''unity''': the only enemy is division. A single person is nothing, a divided host less than nothing, but a united body cannot be defeated — only dissolved from within. Stormrider sees itself as a healer, not a conqueror; outsiders see a horde.

== Philosophy and reputation ==
The one who puts themselves before the body is a disease, not a hero. Stormrider forgives cowardice, stupidity, even betrayal out of loyalty to something greater — never the one who divides for personal gain. Its children grow up in packs, never alone; its leaders are chosen for the ability to ''unite'', not for blood. In battle it moves like an organism, unmatched in coordination.

== Customs ==
* '''The Weaving''' — at decisions, alliances, and successions, a physical line is braided, one strand per party, into one. To refuse to braid in one's strand is a declaration of war. A broken line in the archives is a memorial to a betrayal. ''See [[The Weaving]].''
* '''The song in unison''' — a thousand voices, no soloist.

== The seat ==
[[The Hub]] is a ring-shaped complex where all northern roads run in toward an open central field — no wall, only roads. Nothing is built over the Weaving-ground: ''"what is united shall be seen by all."'' The Hub stands on the War of the Unification's battlefield; you find bones and ash when you dig. The house builds atop it deliberately: all unity rests on what was burned.

== Members (396 A.U.) ==
* '''[[Garron, the Binder]]''' (~64), the sitting uniter — united three generations of division; genuinely loved; dying.
* '''[[Una]]''' (~30), his daughter and advisor — the finest administrator the house has had.
* '''[[Orrin]]''' (~26) — unrelated by blood, with the binder's gift, and no wish for power.
* '''[[Katla]]''' (~50) — "the lone voice," who has warned for decades that the house's story of itself is too clean.
